Awesome Neovim

Collections of awesome Neovim plugins. Mostly targeting Neovim specific features.

Neovim is a Vim-based text editor engineered for extensibility and usability, to encourage new applications and contributions.

Wishlist

Have a problem a plugin can solve? Add it to the nvim-lua wishliststars143.

UI

Neovim supports a wide variety of UI's.

  • CosmicNvim/cosmic-uistars24 - Cosmic-UI is a simple wrapper around specific vim functionality. Built in order to provide a quick and easy way to create a Cosmic UI experience with Neovim!
  • yatli/fvimstars836 - Cross platform Neovim front-end UI, built with F# + Avalonia.
  • smolck/uivonimstars384 - Goal: Feature-rich cross-platform GUI that leverages the latest Neovim features.
  • qvacua/vimrstars5.6k - Neovim GUI for macOS in Swift.
  • vhakulinen/gnvimstars1.5k - GUI for Neovim, without any web bloat.
  • Kethku/neovidestars5.9k - No Nonsense Neovim Client in Rust.
  • beeender/glrnvimstars187 - A terminal wrapper that launches Neovim inside of alacritty.
  • akiyosi/goneovimstars1.5k - Neovim GUI written in Golang, using a Golang qt backend.
  • DinVim - DinVim for macOS is a safe and secure working macOS sandbox environment that provide true macOS experience for Vim users.
  • RMichelsen/Nvystars137 - A Neovim client in C++.
  • asvetliakov/vscode-neovimstars2.5k - Neovim integration for Visual Studio Code.
  • equalsraf/neovim-qtstars1.3k - Neovim client library and GUI, in Qt5.
  • lunixbochs/actualvimstars1.5k - Sublime Text 3 input mode using Neovim.
  • vv-vim/vvstars167 - Neovim client for macOS. A pure, fast, minimalistic Vim experience with good macOS integration. Optimized for speed and nice font rendering.
  • jebberjeb/javafx-neovimpanestars33 - A JavaFX text pane, backed by Neovim, created with Clojure.
  • rohit-px2/nvuistars1.4k - A modern frontend for Neovim.
  • Lyude/neovim-gtkstars22 - A GTK3+ client written in Rust, ressembling a lot the original vim-gtk3 with ligatures support.

Plugin

Plugin Manager

  • wbthomason/packer.nvimstars2k - A use-package inspired plugin manager for Neovim. Uses native packages, supports Luarocks dependencies, written in Lua, allows for expressive config.
  • savq/paq-nvimstars387 - Neovim package manager written in Lua.
  • NTBBloodbath/cheovimstars133 - Neovim configuration switcher written in Lua. Inspired by chemacs.

LSP

(requires Neovim 0.5)

  • neovim/nvim-lspconfigstars3.6k - Quickstart configurations for the Neovim LSP client.
  • nvim-lua/lsp-status.nvimstars403 - This is a Neovim plugin/library for generating statusline components from the built-in LSP client.
  • nvim-lua/lsp_extensions.nvimstars183 - Repo to hold a bunch of info & extension callbacks for built-in LSP.
  • RishabhRD/nvim-lsputilsstars296 - Better defaults for nvim-lsp actions.
  • tami5/lspsaga.nvimstars231 - A light-weight lsp plugin based on Neovim built-in lsp with a highly performant UI.
  • onsails/diaglist.nvimstars75 - Live render workspace diagnostics in quickfix, buffer diagnostics in loclist.
  • folke/trouble.nvimstars1.2k - A pretty diagnostics list to help you solve all the trouble your code is causing.
  • folke/lsp-colors.nvimstars251 - A plugin that adds missing LSP diagnostics highlight groups for color schemes that don't yet support the builtin LSP client.
  • kosayoda/nvim-lightbulbstars367 - The plugin shows a lightbulb in the sign column whenever a textDocument/codeAction is available at the current cursor position.
  • onsails/lspkind-nvimstars395 - The plugin adds vscode-like icons to Neovim lsp completions.
  • ojroques/nvim-lspfuzzystars246 - A small plugin to make the LSP client use FZF.
  • gfanto/fzf-lsp.nvimstars115 - Enable the power of fzf fuzzy search for the Neovim built in lsp.
  • ray-x/lsp_signature.nvimstars709 - Lsp signature hint when you type.
  • rmagatti/goto-previewstars222 - Previewing native LSP's goto definition calls in floating windows.
  • nanotee/sqls.nvimstars48 - Sqls (sql database connection plugin + LSP client) plugin for Neovim.
  • jubnzv/virtual-types.nvimstars119 - Neovim plugin that shows type annotations as virtual text.
  • jose-elias-alvarez/nvim-lsp-ts-utilsstars330 - Utilities to improve the TypeScript development experience for Neovim's built-in LSP client.
  • ray-x/navigator.luastars523 - Learn existing code quickly and navigate code like a breeze. A swiss army knife makes exploring LSP and 🌲Treesitter symbols a piece of 🍰.
  • liuchengxu/vista.vimstars1.5k - List all functions and variables in a window of your current file.
  • simrat39/symbols-outline.nvimstars549 - A tree like view for symbols in Neovim using the Language Server Protocol. Supports all your favourite languages.
  • tamago324/nlsp-settings.nvimstars127 - A plugin for setting Neovim LSP with JSON files.
  • simrat39/rust-tools.nvimstars571 - Tools for better development in rust using Neovim's builtin LSP.
  • stevearc/aerial.nvimstars254 - A code outline window for skimming and quick navigation.
  • jose-elias-alvarez/null-lsstars786 - Use Neovim as a language server to inject LSP diagnostics, code actions, and more via Lua.
  • jakewvincent/texmagic.nvimstars15 - Enhance the lspconfig settings for Texlab by defining any number of custom LaTeX build engines and selecting them with magic comments.
  • nanotee/nvim-lsp-basicsstars12 - Basic wrappers for LSP features.
  • weilbith/nvim-code-action-menustars241 - A floating pop-up menu for code actions to show code action information and a diff preview.
  • mfussenegger/nvim-lintstars244 - An asynchronous linter plugin for Neovim (>= 0.5) complementary to the built-in Language Server Protocol support.
  • b0o/SchemaStore.nvimstars110 - A Neovim Lua plugin providing access to the SchemaStorestars1.5k catalog.
  • ldelossa/litee.nvimstars175 - Neovim's missing IDE features.
LSP Installer
  • anott03/nvim-lspinstallstars84 - Easy to install language servers.
  • alexaandru/nvim-lspupdatestars76 - Updates installed (or auto installs if missing) LSP servers.
  • williamboman/nvim-lsp-installerstars870 - Easily install more than 50+ LSP servers - with full Windows support.

Completion

  • ms-jpq/coq_nvimstars2k - Fast as FUCK Neovim completion. SQLite, concurrent scheduler, hundreds of hours of optimization.
  • jameshiew/nvim-magicstars119 - Framework for integrating AI code assistance.
  • hrsh7th/nvim-cmpstars2k - A completion plugin for Neovim written in Lua. New version of nvim-compe.
    • hrsh7th/cmp-nvim-lspstars155 - A nvim-cmp source for Neovim builtin LSP client.
    • saadparwaiz1/cmp_luasnipstars102 - A nvim-cmp source for luasnip completion.
    • quangnguyen30192/cmp-nvim-ultisnipsstars38 - A nvim-cmp source for UltiSnips.
    • hrsh7th/cmp-pathstars104 - A nvim-cmp source for filesystem paths.
    • petertriho/cmp-gitstars111 - A nvim-cmp source for Git.
    • hrsh7th/cmp-bufferstars97 - A nvim-cmp source for buffer words.
    • tzachar/cmp-tabninestars84 - A nvim-cmp source for TabNine.
    • hrsh7th/cmp-nvim-luastars65 - A nvim-cmp source for the Neovim Lua API.
    • lukas-reineke/cmp-rgstars110 - A nvim-cmp source for Ripgrep.
    • f3fora/cmp-spellstars49 - A nvim-cmp source for vim's spellsuggest.
    • andersevenrud/compe-tmuxstars59 - A nvim-cmp source for Tmux.
    • David-Kunz/cmp-npmstars53 - A nvim-cmp source for NPM.
    • lukas-reineke/cmp-under-comparatorstars65 - A nvim-cmp function for better sorting.
  • mini.completionstars210 - Module of echasnovski/mini.nvimstars210 for asynchronous two-stage completion. Supports showing completion item info and independent function signature.

Markdown

  • ellisonleao/glow.nvimstars353 - Markdown preview using glow.
  • davidgranstrom/nvim-markdown-previewstars37 - Markdown preview in the browser using pandoc and live-server through Neovim's job-control API.
  • jghauser/auto-pandoc.nvimstars7 - Easy pandoc conversion leveraging yaml blocks.
  • jghauser/follow-md-links.nvimstars23 - Press enter to follow internal markdown links.
  • jakewvincent/mkdnflow.nvimstars73 - Markdown notebook navigation (follow internal and external markdown links, create links, jump to links, etc.)
  • jubnzv/mdeval.nvimstars38 - A Neovim plugin that evaluates code blocks inside markdown documents.
  • mjlbach/babelfish.nvimstars44 - A Neovim plugin to convert Markdown to vimdoc using Treesitter.
  • kdheepak/panvimdocstars52 - A pandoc to vimdoc GitHub action.

Syntax

  • nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitterstars3.1k - Neovim Treesitter configurations and abstraction layer.
  • nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter-textobjectsstars517 - Create your own textobjects using tree-sitter queries.
  • RRethy/nvim-treesitter-textsubjectsstars189 - Location and syntax aware text objects which do what you mean.
  • blackCauldron7/surround.nvimstars247 - A surround text object plugin for Neovim written in Lua.
  • mini.surroundstars210 - Module of echasnovski/mini.nvimstars210 for working with text surroundings (add, delete, replace, find, highlight). Fully supports dot-repeat.

Terminal integration

  • LoricAndre/OneTerm.nvimstars22 - Plugin framework for running commands in the terminal.
  • nikvdp/neomuxstars177 - Control Neovim from shells running inside Neovim.
  • akinsho/nvim-toggleterm.luastars675 - A Neovim Lua plugin to help easily manage multiple terminal windows.
  • norcalli/nvim-terminal.luastars97 - A high performance filetype mode for Neovim which leverages conceal and highlights your buffer with the correct color codes.
  • numToStr/FTerm.nvimstars318 - No nonsense floating terminal written in Lua.
  • oberblastmeister/termwrapper.nvimstars16 - Wrapper for Neovim's terminal features to make them more user friendly.
  • pianocomposer321/consolation.nvimstars13 - A general-purpose terminal wrapper and management plugin for Neovim, written in Lua.
  • jghauser/kitty-runner.nvimstars10 - Poor man's REPL. Easily send buffer lines and commands to a kitty terminal.
  • jlesquembre/nterm.nvimstars32 - A Neovim plugin to interact with the terminal, with notifications.
  • s1n7ax/nvim-terminalstars36 - A simple & easy to use multi-terminal plugin.

Snippet

  • norcalli/snippets.nvimstars236 - Snippets in Lua.
  • hrsh7th/vim-vsnipstars532 - Snippet plugin for vim/nvim that supports LSP/VSCode's snippet format.
  • rafamadriz/friendly-snippetsstars285 - Snippets collection for all kind of programming languages that integrates really well with vim-vsnip.
  • L3MON4D3/LuaSnipstars548 - A snippet engine for Neovim written in Lua.
  • dcampos/nvim-snippystars62 - Snippet plugin written in Lua with support for vim-snippetsstars4.1k.

Register

  • gennaro-tedesco/nvim-peekupstars120 - Dynamically interact with vim registers.
  • tversteeg/registers.nvimstars336 - Non-obtrusive minimal preview of vim registers.
  • acksld/nvim-neoclip.luastars307 - Clipboard manager Neovim plugin with telescope integration.

Marks

  • chentau/marks.nvimstars181 - A better user experience for viewing and interacting with vim marks.

Fuzzy Finder

  • nvim-telescope/telescope.nvimstars4.6k - Telescope.nvim is a highly extendable fuzzy finder over lists. Built on the latest awesome features from Neovim core. Telescope is centered around modularity, allowing for easy customization.
  • vijaymarupudi/nvim-fzfstars215 - A Lua API for using fzf in Neovim (>= 0.5). Allows for full asynchronicity for UI speed and usability.
  • amirrezaask/fuzzy.nvimstars49 - Fuzzy.nvim provides a simple mechanism and pipeline to create fuzzy matching in Neovim.
  • camspiers/snapstars352 - An extensible fuzzy finder. Similar to Telescope, and optimized for performance, especially when grepping in large codebases.
  • ibhagwan/fzf-luastars317 - The Lua version of fzf.vim, high-performance and fully async, supports nvim-web-devicons, git indicators, LSP, quickfix/location lists and more. Also supports skim as its fzf binary.
  • jvgrootveld/telescope-zoxidestars62 - Telescope integration for zoxidestars5k, a smart directory picker that tracks your usage.
  • mini.fuzzystars210 - Module of echasnovski/mini.nvimstars210 with functions to perform fuzzy matching of one string to others along with fast Telescope sorter.

Note Taking

  • oberblastmeister/neuron.nvimstars275 - Note taking plugin for neuron that integrates with telescope.nvim.

Colorscheme

Tree-sitter Supported Colorscheme

Tree-sitter is a new system coming in Neovim 0.5 that incrementally parses your code into a tree that works, even with errors in your syntax. These colorschemes have specifically set colors for Tree-sitter highlight groups. Vim colorschemes will work with the new groups out of the box.

  • abecodes/tabout.nvimstars212 - Jump out of brackets, quotes, objects, etc.
  • ethanholz/nvim-lastplacestars81 - Reopen files at your last edit position.
  • Allendang/nvim-expand-exprstars19 - Expand and repeat expression to multiple lines.
  • h-hg/fcitx.nvimstars18 - Switching and restoring fcitx state for each buffer seperately.
  • McAuleyPenney/tidy.nvimstars15 - Clear trailing whitespace and empty lines at end of file on every save.
  • mini.trailspacestars210 - Module of echasnovski/mini.nvimstars210 for automatic highlighting of trailing whitespace with functionality to remove it.
  • filipdutescu/renamer.nvimstars134 - VS Code-like renaming UI for Neovim, writen in Lua.
  • gbprod/cutlass.nvimstars33 - Plugin that adds a 'cut' operation separate from 'delete'.
  • gbprod/substitute.nvimstars15 - Neovim plugin introducing a new operator motions to quickly replace text.
  • sQVe/sort.nvimstars31 - Sorting plugin that intelligently supports line-wise and delimiter sorting.
  • booperlv/nvim-gomovestars55 - A complete plugin for moving and duplicating blocks and lines, with complete fold handling, reindenting, and undoing in one go.

Formatting

  • mhartington/formatter.nvimstars413 - A format runner for Neovim written in Lua.
  • lukas-reineke/format.nvimstars189 - Fast asynchronous formatting for Neovim. Supports formatting embedded code blocks.
  • sbdchd/neoformatstars1.3k - A (Neo)vim plugin for formatting code.

Web development

  • NTBBloodbath/rest.nvimstars256 - A fast Neovim http client written in Lua.

Media

  • ekickx/clipboard-image.nvimstars89 - Neovim Lua plugin to paste image from clipboard.
  • gwatcha/reaper-keysstars60 - Modal keybindings for Reaper DAW.
  • madskjeldgaard/reaper-nvimstars30 - Remote control Reaper DAW from Neovim.
  • davidgranstrom/scnvimstars88 - Neovim frontend for SuperCollider.

Discord Rich Presence

  • andweeb/presence.nvimstars191 - Fast and lite Discord Rich Presence plugin for Neovim written in Lua.

Command Line

  • notomo/cmdbuf.nvimstars37 - Alternative command-line-window plugin.
  • gelguy/wilder.nvimstars546 - A plugin for fuzzy command line autocompletion.

Session

  • rmagatti/auto-sessionstars320 - A small automated session manager for Neovim.
  • mini.sessionsstars210 - Module of echasnovski/mini.nvimstars210 for session management (read, write, delete).

Test

  • rcarriga/vim-ulteststars271 - The ultimate testing plugin for NeoVim.
  • David-Kunz/jesterstars43 - A Neovim plugin to easily run and debug Jest tests.

Preconfigured Configuration

  • SpaceVim/SpaceVim - A community-driven modular vim/neovim distribution, like spacemacs but for vim/neovim.
  • CosmicNvim/CosmicNvimstars300 - CosmicNvim is a lightweight and opinionated Neovim config for web development, specifically designed to provide a 💫 COSMIC programming experience!
  • artart222/CodeArtstars687 - A fast general-purpose IDE written entirely in Lua with an installer for Linux/Windows/macOS and built in :CodeArtUpdate command for updating it.
  • NTBBloodbath/doom-nvimstars478 - Port of the doom-emacs framework, its goal is to add useful functions to Neovim to start working in a stable and efficient development environment without spending a lot of time configuring everything.
  • crivotz/nv-idestars223 - Neovim custom configuration, oriented for full stack developers (rails, ruby, php, html, css, SCSS, JavaScript).
  • ChristianChiarulli/LunarVimstars6.9k - This project aims to help one transition away from VSCode, and into a superior text editing experience.
  • hackorum/VapourNvimstars272 - A NeoVim config for THE ULTIMATE vim IDE-like experience.
  • vi-tality/neovitalitystars27 - A full-featured NeoVim distribution, packaged with Nix Flake for easy installation and reproducibility.
  • siduck76/NvChadstars7.6k - An attempt to make Neovim cli as functional as an IDE while being very beautiful and less bloated.
  • ashincoder/StarVimstars38 - A IDE wrapper which is beyond the moon 🌝 and above the stars ⭐.
  • mjlbach/defaults.nvimstars742 - An extremely small, single file, and commented configuration template demonstrating LSP integration, autocompletion, snippets, treesitter, and more.
  • cstsunfu/.sea.nvimstars27 - A modular NeoVim configuration with beautiful UI and some useful features(Pomodoro Clock, Window Number).
  • shaeinst/roshnivimstars47 - Roshnivim, can be called neovim's distro, is a predefined configs so that you don't need 1000hr to setup neovim as an IDE.

Keybinding

  • AckslD/nvim-whichkey-setup.luastars54 - Plugin that wraps vim-which-key to simplify setup in Lua.
  • folke/which-key.nvimstars1k - Neovim plugin that shows a popup with possible keybindings of the command you started typing.
  • Iron-E/nvim-cartographerstars42 - a more convenient :mapping syntax for Lua environments.
  • b0o/mapx.nvimstars119 - A simpler key mapping API that mimics Neovim's :map-family of commands. Integrates with which-key.nvim.
  • LionC/nest.nvimstars171 - Lua utility to map keys concisely using cascading trees. Also allows binding Lua functions to keys.
  • LinArcX/telescope-command-palette.nvimstars72 - Lua plugin to create key-bindings and watch them with telescope.

Tmux

  • aserowy/tmux.nvimstars131 - Tmux integration for Neovim features pane movement and resizing from within Neovim.
  • danielpieper/telescope-tmuxinator.nvimstars8 - Integration for tmuxinator with telescope.nvim.
  • hkupty/nvimuxstars357 - Neovim as tmux replacement.
  • numToStr/Navigator.nvimstars114 - Smoothly navigate between Neovim splits and Tmux panes.

Remote Development

  • chipsenkbeil/distant.nvimstars380 - Edit files, run programs, and work with LSP on a remote machine from the comfort of your local environment.
  • jamestthompson3/nvim-remote-containersstars168 - Develop inside docker containers, just like VSCode.

Split and Window

  • henriquehbr/ataraxis.luastars11 - A zen mode for improving code readability on Neovim.
  • gitlab.com/yorickpeterse/nvim-window - Easily jump between Neovim windows.
  • sindrets/winshift.nvimstars125 - Rearrange your windows with ease.
  • beauwilliams/focus.nvimstars220 - Auto-Focusing and Auto-Resizing Splits/Windows for Neovim written in Lua! Vim splits on steroids.
  • luukvbaal/stabilize.nvimstars198 - Stabilized window content on window open/close events.

External

These tools are used externally to Neovim to enhance the experience.

Version Manager

  • NTBBloodbath/nvenvstars17 - A lightweight and blazing fast Neovim version manager.
  • shohi/nevastars8 - A Neovim version manager written in Lua.

Boilerplate

  • gennaro-tedesco/boilitstars31 - Create boilerplate structure for Neovim plugins.

Vim

  • Vimawesome - Showcases various plugins for vim and has a neovim tag for other plugins targeting Neovim.

Resource

  • Neovimcraft - A site dedicated to searching for Neovim specific plugins and guides for building plugins in Lua.
